# Lib.laser.convert

## Operators

- [**LaserPointsToBuffer**](LaserPointsToBuffer.md) — Converts a laser point list into a GPU point buffer, bridging laser frames back into the graph.
- [**MeshToLaserPoints**](MeshToLaserPoints.md) — Converts a mesh into laser points as wireframe runs or vertex dots.
- [**ImageToLaserPoints**](ImageToLaserPoints.md) — Vectorizes a texture into laser shapes: skeleton centerlines, region outlines or Canny edges.
